story_overview: At The Stone Manor, a group of friends including Clara, Leo, Tom, and Roger work together to landscape the patio area with potted plants. After their work, they relax by the pool. The story continues with Leo and Clara leaving The Red Barn and concludes with Leo walking down a street in an adobe town.

video_prompts:
Mark: Man in a light yellow long-sleeved shirt and dark pants.
Clara: Woman with short blonde hair, wearing a green long-sleeved shirt, dark leggings, and a watch on her wrist.
The Stone Manor: A large, two-story stone house with a large stone stoop at the entrance and grounds featuring green Japanese Maple Shrubs.
the weathered plank door: Heavy, rectangular door made of dark, weathered vertical wood planks with prominent black wrought iron strap hinges and a matching iron latch.
the heavy wooden door: Large, heavy wooden door constructed from dark, weathered vertical planks, featuring prominent black wrought-iron strap hinges and a large iron ring pull handle.
Mark and Clara stand on the stone stoop of The Stone Manor, talking in front of the heavy wooden door. They finish their conversation, turn, and walk down the steps together, exiting the frame.

Tom: Man wearing a green shirt and tan pants.
the collection of potted plants: A collection of numerous potted plants with dark green foliage, contained in an assortment of planters of different shapes, sizes, and materials, including terracotta pots and stone containers.
the small white table: Small white table.
Time-lapse, medium shot of the stone patio in The Stone Manor. Tom moves quickly, setting up a seating area. He places the small white table and the simple white bench on the patio, then arranges the potted plants from the collection of potted plants around them and on the table.

Leo: Man with short brown hair, wearing a light blue button-down shirt, dark blue jeans, and a silver watch on his left wrist.
Roger: Man with a mustache, wearing a cream-colored short-sleeved shirt and grey pants.

In The Stone Manor, Leo, Clara, and Roger stand together on a stone patio. Clara gestures toward the collection of potted plants, then bends down to touch one of them. Leo and Roger watch her and listen.

the outdoor AC unit: Large, box-shaped metal outdoor air conditioning unit with louvered vents on the sides and a circular protective grille over a fan on its top surface.

Daytime on the stone patio at The Stone Manor. Leo and Roger work together to lift and place a large, dark pot from the collection of potted plants. They set it down on the stone pavers in front of the outdoor AC unit. After they set it down, Leo walks away to the left while Roger looks on.

Close-up on Leo and Clara standing together at The Stone Manor, examining plants in the collection of potted plants. The shot widens as they walk along the side of the house, pointing at and discussing the different potted plants.

the small white chairs: Two small, white patio chairs.

Clara stands on the stone patio, looking at the collection of potted plants. In the background, the small white table and the small white chairs are also on the patio near the house.

During the day, at The Stone Manor, Clara, wearing her green long-sleeved tunic, and Roger stand talking. They are next to the collection of potted plants. Clara gestures towards the collection of potted plants as they converse.

the white Adirondack chairs: Two white Adirondack-style chairs, each with a high, slanted back made of vertical slats and wide, flat armrests

Wide shot of the backyard of The Stone Manor on a clear day, with the white Adirondack chairs visible. Roger walks onto the stone patio. An in-ground swimming pool is on the right. A black metal fence stands on the left, with lush green trees in the background.

On the stone patio of The Stone Manor, Roger, Tom, and Clara stand together by a swimming pool. Roger gestures towards the collection of potted plants as he speaks. Tom and Clara watch him, nodding in understanding.

Nathan: Young man with black hair, wearing a grey hoodie and jeans.
the sparkling lime drink: A tall glass containing a light-colored, bubbly beverage with ice cubes and a slice of lime on the rim.
the 'Ask This Old House' graphic: A graphic overlay featuring the text 'ask This Old House' and decorative tool motifs.
